_note: Every value here is a business rule Raghav must sign off. Items marked ASSUMED are placeholders until procurement confirms them.

forecast._festival_note: Uplift applies only to forward-looking weeks that fall in a festival month (by ISO-week Thursday). Never to the 4-vs-12 week trend comparison.

lead_time_weeks._status: ASSUMED - supplier lead times are not in SAP export; confirm with procurement

shelf_life_weeks._status: ASSUMED - fill in from QA for perishables; caps order-up-to so stock never outlives shelf life

segmentation._abc_note: By 12-week unit volume (no prices in the export). Switch to revenue once SAP adds list price.

routing._auto_note: Empty during the parallel run: Raghav approves every order. Once the override log shows he rarely changes routine orders for steady SKUs, add e.g. ["AX", "BX"].
